background: Wei Zheng’s remonstrance, written at the emperor’s summer palace and transcribed by Ouyang Xun. The stone still stands inside the protected palace site; the bureau lists it among the site’s surviving monuments.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from an official reply that names the stele but does not describe it in detail.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据文物局答复函整理的草稿；该函只提及碑名与所在遗址，未详述碑况。

notes: The cited reply gives no date, dimensions, or condition for the stone; the composition year is not stated there.
